description: Finds 4OVER4 print guides, business print kits, product comparisons and case studies; use it when someone asks for a guide, a kit or a comparison page about printing. For support questions use search_knowledge; for products use show_products. Inputs are optional: query searches all the pages, types browses one kind, and slug with one type opens one item. Returns pages with links, or one page's detail. Customer phrases: "guides on file prep", "case studies for restaurants", "print kits for a new business".

slug.description: One item's slug, the last segment of its page address, sent with exactly one type in types.

types.description: Content types to search or browse.

name: search_content

data.description: Editorial pages (kits, guides, comparisons, case studies) or one page's detail.

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.

summary.description: The facts of the result in plain sentences.

title: Search 4OVER4 guides and pages
